description: Publishes a company's own models, datasets and Spaces demos on the Hugging Face Hub - org verification, repo-per-variant layout, card metadata, license and gating (incl. EU AI Act open-weights duties), demo Spaces, inference widgets, trending and the Community tab. Use whenever a team plans a model or dataset release on Hugging Face, asks whether to gate it, why their model has no traction or no inference widget, how to trend on HF, or what their Hub downloads mean - even if they only say "our model goes on HF". Publisher side only, not for choosing or deploying someone else's model. Do NOT use for PyPI or npm releases of the loading library - use samber/developer-platform-skills@sdk-package-publishing; or cross-channel launch planning - use samber/developer-relations-skills@oss-launch.
